The house

Four rooms among the trees a balcony facing Ella Rock and breakfast carried to your door each morning. Small on purpose — so every stay feels like your own house in the hills five minutes from the heart of Ella.

Four rooms,
four views

King-size mattresses, hot water and air conditioning, warm pine and teak — each room its own private vantage point over the valley.

A morning
ritual

The best part of a stay here happens before nine o’clock.

6:30
First light

Curtains open on Ella Rock

Floor-to-ceiling windows and a spacious balcony — the rock face catches the morning sun across the valley.

Breakfast

Served to your balcony

A home-made Sri Lankan breakfast is carried up to your room every morning — hoppers, eggs, toast, fresh fruit and juice, with the mountain as the backdrop.

Breakfast was delivered to our balcony every morning by our friendly host.Sinead R · Tripadvisor
Made by the family

Home-cooked, generous

The family who run the house prepare everything themselves — and are happy to help plan your day around Ella.

The breakfasts were prepared by his wife, and were delicious.Peter G · United Kingdom
Into the hills

Trails from the door

Ella Rock, Little Adam’s Peak and Nine Arches Bridge are all close — or walk five minutes into town for coffee.

Ella Rock — Ella Rock — Ella Rock

The view guests
come back for

Panoramic views of Ella Rock and the surrounding countryside from the balcony — the house sits among green vegetation a few hundred metres above the lively town centre.

Quietly
taken care of

Small and personal — the family arranges pickups, transfers and anything you need around Ella.
